verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms documents holding funds in user balance accounts until payout, with release either on a managed payout schedule or through custom payouts where the platform controls timing. That covers the core hold-and-release idea. However, the docs shown never describe escrow-like holds tied to delivery or dispute windows, nor any limits on how long funds can be held. Missing for 10: explicit delivery/dispute-window hold mechanics, documented hold limits or maximum durations, an explicit event-triggered release API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, funds can wait — hold seller funds in a balance until delivery or dispute windows pass, release on my schedule or trigger, with the escrow-like mechanics and their limits documented
